text: Onon ɓee yimɓe, ɗaɓɓiree Joomi mon haforaneede junuubi, ruttoron e Makko ninsugol e kon ko fantinɗon e Makko. O dakmitiray on ka nguurndam aduna dakamme labaaɗo haa e waqtu lannugol laje mon happaaɗe ɗen, O jonna kala jom ɓural ka ɗoftaare e ka golle, njoɓdi ɓural Makko ngal no timmiri hara ɗuytaaki. Si on ɗuurnike gomɗingol ko mi addi kon immorde ka Joomi am, haray min mi hulanii on lepte ñalaande kulol sattunde, nden woni Ñalaande Darngal.
